David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The ping-pong room looked quieter than usual that evening. Cancel an appointment by text if you must.
People around David often share different ideas about the ping-pong room. David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. They play tennis on Sundays.

Jack and David are preparing a report about the ping-pong room. Little by little, things began to change. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. A water birth eased the contractions.

On Wednesday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. The bike lane has become an important part of daily life. The experience taught David more than any book could. Cataracts now mean day surgery.
Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. David usually spends the weekend reading at the library. David's dream job is to be a nurse.
